title: Regional GeoJSON choropleth
intent: Compare regional values using a compact GeoJSON choropleth map.

ai.create: Create a six-region choropleth from a typed GeoJSON feature collection. Plot should use geo with an identity projection; TanStack should inject d3-geo and render one path per feature through geoShape.
ai.maintain: Keep projection fitting responsive, preserve feature identity and literal fills, and leave geographic projection code outside the ordinary cartesian bundle.
